environment: Disposable NixOS QEMU/KVM Wayland guests; actual catalogue executables and hooks; live Netherlands VPN with exclusive forwarded ports
method: Peer-only full downloads, SHA256 verification, incoming established connections on the leased port, independent public TCP handshake. rTorrent additionally checked its forwarded UDP listener with conflicting saved port/DHT preferences. Each launch has a 1.25 GiB combined traffic budget.

comparison.note: Different endpoints and times; short interface peaks include protocol traffic. Observation times include startup, polling and verification. These measurements do not establish sustained line-rate performance or a permanent maximum.

limitations: The first three clients used separate fresh-download and resumed forwarding checks; their original independent probe ran too early.
Initial retained fixtures exhausted the default disposable application quota; failure disks were preserved and testing continued on a clone with a 5 GiB application budget.
Earlier rTorrent checks missed dual-stack TCP sockets; final validation checks TCP and TCP6.
No physical-GPU validation or guarantee against future provider, tracker, swarm or network changes.
